commonPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE full-screen portrait Android mobile UI design image, 412:892 proportions, high resolution, crisp legible simplified Chinese. Input images are REFERENCES ONLY: accepted-chat is authoritative composition and spacing; accepted-mascot authoritative character identity; P09 authoritative grouped settings styling; P15 authoritative keyboard/composer behavior. Follow the original closely, no redesign. Pure white #FFFFFF background, pale pink #F8D5DE controls, #FFF1F5 surfaces, deep rose #925568 accents, charcoal text, subtle thin gray borders, generous whitespace. Small ORIGINAL pink folded bookmark character with apricot upper-right folded corner, cream back page, V-notch bottom, tiny black eyes; never a green sprout, marshmallow, robot or unrelated character. Maximum one character per screen. Clean rounded corners and understated outlines; avoid dense bordered assistant bubbles and repeated avatars. Top bar centered concise title, left menu/back, right clearly recognizable SETTINGS gear on main chat. Main pages only: four bottom destinations 聊天 材料 记忆 成果. Configuration/detail screens use back navigation with NO bottom bar. Chat composer follows original exactly: attachment button LEFT outside field, model selector INSIDE field RIGHT separated by thin vertical divider, round send/stop RIGHT outside field; no separate model-chip row, no giant input outlines. Adapt to existing general-purpose HXsi app capabilities, not math-only branding. All content illustrative for design review; no real credentials, invented online test success, or claims of finished feature support. No device bezel, perspective, collage, watermark, explanatory captions outside screen.
